decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 25 Campion Road, Isleworth.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 5pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of theLocal Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Part ground floor and part two storey side extension, and ground floor rear extension to house including conversion of the garage to habitable room.
